milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate within 5 blocks of the dark_oak_fence_gate at spawn-relative (8, 0, 2) and face it (60° tolerance). Distance reduced from 16 to 5 per Validator feedback to ensure the player actively walks toward the gate rather than satisfying it from spawn (~8.25 blocks away).

Uses position_near_with_facing because there is no 'interact_block' event in the available rule types. The player must be within 3 blocks of the blast furnace at spawn-relative (8, 1, 8) and face it (60° tolerance). This 3-block distance matches Minecraft's interaction range (~4.5 blocks) and ensures the player entered the workshop and is positioned to right-click the furnace.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate within 5 blocks of the yellow_wall_banner at spawn-relative (10, 2, 7) and face it (60° tolerance). The banner is on the workshop's east exterior wall facing west, so the player must be inside the fenced area looking at the wall to satisfy this. Distance reduced from 16 to 5 per Validator feedback.

Uses position_near_with_facing as the best available proxy because there is no 'use_item' rule type and inventory_has cannot check for item absence (min_count must be ≥1). The player must be within 3 blocks of the banner location at spawn-relative (10, 2, 7) with facing_tolerance=180 (no facing requirement, distance-only). The tighter 3-block radius (vs 5 for milestone 3) ensures the player moved closer after finding the banner, implying task progression. This is a known limitation documented here.
